title: Data analyst evidence
text: Strong data analyst resumes make the decision context visible: the business question, the data used, the analysis method, and the measurable result. Look for SQL, spreadsheets, BI tools, experimentation, dashboards, data quality, and communication with non-technical partners. Do not assume a tool was used unless the resume names it.

title: Data analyst scope
text: For an analyst role, a project bullet is more credible when it explains who used the work and what changed after it. A dashboard without an audience or decision is a deliverable, not evidence of impact. Career changers should connect transferable problem-solving work to the target role without pretending it was already analytics work.

title: Software engineer evidence
text: Strong software engineering resumes show what was built, the technical constraint, the candidate's contribution, and the outcome. Useful evidence may include system boundaries, reliability, performance, tests, deployment, ownership, collaboration, and measured scale. A list of languages without applied context is weak evidence.

title: Software engineer seniority
text: Senior engineering evidence includes decisions that changed a system or team: design trade-offs, incident prevention, mentoring, cross-functional delivery, or operating a service in production. Do not infer seniority from years alone. The resume should show a scope of responsibility that supports the claim.

title: Marketing manager evidence
text: Strong marketing resumes connect a campaign or channel to an audience, objective, execution, and outcome. Useful evidence can include pipeline, revenue, conversion, retention, qualified leads, acquisition cost, audience growth, budget, or experiment results. Posting frequency by itself is not impact.

title: Marketing manager scope
text: For a marketing manager role, distinguish doing a task from directing a program. Evidence of prioritization, channel strategy, stakeholder alignment, budget responsibility, and learning from results can support management scope. Do not confuse a job title with proof of leadership.

title: Evidence and clarity
text: Across roles, a useful resume helps a hurried reader answer three questions: what did this person do, how well did they do it, and why does it matter for this target role? Specific outcomes beat duty lists. Missing information should be named as missing, never invented.
